basic_information.official_title: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A COMPLETE AND INTEGRATED SYSTEM OF QUALITY EDUCATION IN THE BANGSAMORO (EDUCATION CODE)

citizen_summary.what_is_this_about: Provides for a Complete and Integrated System of Quality Education in the Bangsamoro (education Code).
citizen_summary.why_was_it_proposed: First of the seven priority codes mandated by the Bangsamoro Organic Law to be enacted.
citizen_summary.what_will_change: Provides for a Complete and Integrated System of Quality Education in the Bangsamoro (education Code).
citizen_summary.when_will_it_take_effect: Ratified 2021-05-18; effectivity per the Act's final section (typically 15 days after Official Gazette publication).

what_this_means_for_you.in_short: The Education Code sets up the Bangsamoro's own integrated school system - basic education, madaris (Islamic schools), technical and higher education - under MBHTE. It shapes what your children learn, how teachers are hired, and how madrasah education is recognized alongside the regular curriculum.
in_practice: Integrates Arabic language and Islamic values education options in public schools
Provides the legal basis for recognizing and supporting madaris and their asatidz (teachers)
Governs teacher hiring and school building priorities in the region

for_specific_groups.Parents: Choice and recognition for both regular and madrasah tracks
for_specific_groups.Madrasah teachers: Pathway to recognition, standards, and support
for_specific_groups.Students: Scholarships and the Bangsamoro Science High School System (BAA 40) build on this Code

what_this_means_for_you.where_this_applies: All of BARMM unless the title names a specific place
what_this_means_for_you.when_you_will_feel_it: Laws take effect shortly after publication, but felt impact follows budgets, IRRs, and agency rollout - typically months, not days
what_you_can_do: Ask your municipal/barangay office or the implementing ministry how and when it will roll out where you live
Read the full text (PDF) on the Parliament's website or the Official Gazette of the Bangsamoro - the final sections say when it takes effect and who must act
If it isn't being implemented, raise it with your Member of Parliament or through the ministry's public assistance desk

key_terms_explained.BAA: Bangsamoro Autonomy Act - a regional law passed by the Bangsamoro Parliament, applying inside BARMM alongside national laws.
key_terms_explained.IRR: Implementing Rules and Regulations - the ministry-issued 'how-to' that turns a law's text into procedures; many laws only bite once the IRR is out.
key_terms_explained.GAA: General Appropriations Act - the annual budget law deciding how much each ministry and program gets.

benefits.headline: An education system built for Bangsamoro learners - including madaris.

direct_benefits.benefit: Recognition and support for madrasah education alongside the regular track
Arabic and Islamic values education options in public schools
The legal base for scholarships and the Science High School System (BAA 40)

indirect_benefits: Teachers' hiring and school-building priorities set regionally, closer to needs
limitations: Benefits arrive only as fast as funds are released and the implementing office organizes - expect a lag between enactment and service.
